notes.content:

[h1][b]Launch discount 20%[/b] for a full week to celebrate It![/h1] 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/395930/][img]http://cs622726.vk.me/v622726644/3ecd1/5SIMaeh8_B4.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]*Special price ends at 2nd of September![/i]

notes.title: Six games for friends to celebrate release 'Moai 2: Path to Another World' on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Friends![/h1]

Special for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/296240]The Promised Land[/url] fans [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Buka%20Entertainment]Buka Entertainment[/url] to celebrate thier new release on Steam [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/361950]Moai 2: Path to Another World[/url] want to give you a chance to get 6 games fo free!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/361950[i]*Archievments and Trading Cards included[/i]

Also Buka makes a special price for owners first game of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/338980/]Moai: Build Your Dream[/url]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/338980/][img] https://pp.vk.me/c629102/v629102644/64d4/JHjguNQsMCY.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]You can grab 6 excellent casual  games :[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/361950]MOAI 2: Path to Another World[/url]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/361930/]Farm Frenzy: Hurricane Season[/url]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/320630]Season Match[/url]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/338960]Rescue Team[/url]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/352130]Locoland[/url]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/352140]Finders[/url][/list]
[h1]Just change the sign [b]*[/b] to correct number;)[/h1]
[olist]
[*]YNLTR-XN4RX-*QW7P
[*]GVAE6-YY*GG-WJLL9
[*]XP*GR-JNJX*-CYBHP
[*]*B53*-XMT4Y-JH9EL
[*]5HCWD-EIT*L-LCGGN
[*]VP*F0-7BCFC-J5RKK
[/olist]

[h1]Good Luck, friends! [i] And pls don't be too greedy!;)[/i]ːredhotː[/h1]
